evidence: Film Deposition: SnS 2 films were deposited using a commercial hotwall, cross-flow type ALD reactor (F120, ASM Microchemistry) using tin(IV) acetate [Sn(OAc) 4 ] and hydrogen sulfide (H 2 S) as precursors. Nitrogen (N 2 , AGA, 99.999%) at a flow rate of 400 sccm was used as a carrier and purge gas at a pressure of approximately 5 mbar.
